paragraphs: Good morning. This is Leo Ward with Good Morning AI. Friday, November 27. The previous twenty-four hours in AI and space.

sections.headline: Children stake in future; orbital data centers
sections.dek: Vital stake for next generation. Starmind conditional approval. No launch.
sections.reaction: No new launch in the window.
paragraphs: SpaceX and xAI: Elon Musk emphasized that it is vital that children have a stake in the future following the share commitment to millions of American children. Reports of FCC conditional approval for up to one million Starmind orbital data center satellites for solar-powered AI compute. No new launch in the window.
